verdict.rationale: Rule-based event automation is a fair question for a financial infrastructure platform, but the pack shows no user-definable rules engine that triggers actions on events. A webhook events page (unit-docs-25) is a developer building block. Configurable card controls and real-time authorization (unit-docs-3) are adjacent features. The vague reference to 'flows to automate lending and repayments' (unit-docs-15) does not describe user-defined event-to-action rules.
